verdict.rationale: Private networking is a fair axis for a cloud deployment platform, but the evidence never documents keeping service-to-service traffic off the public internet. The related items only cover access control on public URLs: Vercel Authentication, passwords and trusted IPs, IdP-secured internal apps, and firewall rules. A community comment also suggests secure database connectivity beyond passwords requires contacting enterprise sales, but it names no concrete product, so this capability is undocumented here.
